forecastReasoning.narrative:
Classic Dryline Cyclone governs the 12Z Day 1–12Z Day 2 period. The 12Z Day 1 issuance carries a MDT maximum, with Slight-or-greater probabilities covering 34% of the domain. The primary corridor peaks near 12Z Day 1, when mean initiation reaches 12% and expected storm coverage reaches 5%.

A lee cyclone, sharpening dryline, and elevated mixed layer organize the warm sector while ascent approaches from the west. A representative corridor sounding contains about 2892 J/kg CAPE, 355 m²/s² SRH, 62 kt deep-layer shear, 2105 m LCLs, STP 4.1, and VTP 1.3. Flow increases from roughly 24 kt at 850 mb to 47 kt at 500 mb and 61 kt at 250 mb.

Maximum probabilities are 15% tornado, 30% hail, and 5% wind; large hail is the leading hazard signal. The analog ensemble has high agreement (94% confidence; 30 members), with mean moisture return 78%, clearing 90%, forcing 75%, and cap persistence 68%. No ensemble failure mode exceeds the reporting threshold.
